bots.kid: slow and sloppy: 350 ms reaction, short sight, sprays the gun, loses attention
bots.average: ordinary player: 250 ms reaction, plans one swing ahead, loose aim
bots.good: skilled player: 180 ms reaction, plans swings to collect, leads targets
bots.oracle: no delay, no error, sees everything spawned: its deaths approximate unfair situations
bots.camper: average player who never shoots and parks away from raiders (safe-spot exploit), still collects gems
bots.spinner: holds one steer key for the whole run and fires constantly (endless-spin exploit)
bots.tapper: rests at the bottom, shoots raiders on its line, answers a tell on its line with one 150 ms tap away
bots.passive: no input at all: the craft hangs at the bottom
bots.miner: the good player, and it shoots every mine on its line that is outside the danger distance
